§6Dimensional Hazards§f

§aCustom dimensions collapse when power fails, here's how to not die in one.§f

If the §bDimension Builder§f hits §e0 RF§f, your pocket dimension collapses. Lethal void damage, no survivors, items lost. Fun.

§6Phased Field Generator (PFG)§f:
Keep this charged handheld device in your inventory at all times inside custom dimensions:
§b• Buffer§f: §e1,000,000 RF§f, charges at §e1,000 RF/t§f
§b• Emergency Shield§f: If the dimension collapses, the PFG auto-triggers a personal forcefield blocking all lethal damage for §c100 RF/t§f, enough time to teleport out

§6Activity Probe§f:
Place this inside your dimension to §ahalt power consumption when nobody's online§f. Saves your base's energy reserve from draining while you're away.

§cWARNING:§f Always carry a fully-charged PFG. One collapse can cost you everything.
